page.overview:
Who is Crystal Beau?

Crystal Beau is a Crystal Earth pony stallion with a light teal coat, deep teal mane and tail, purple eyes, and a cutie mark of a bow and arrow. He has a speaking role in The Crystal Empire - Part 2. He is unnamed in the show, but he is named in merchandise.__TOC__

Crystal Beau shares his design with "Night Knight", Periwinkle Pace, and "Sand Arrow".

Crystal Beau first appears in The Crystal Empire - Part 1 during Princess Celestia's flashback of the Crystal Empire, shown to be in the forced servitude of King Sombra. Later in the episode, he is one of many Crystal Ponies having become depressed as a result of King Sombra's curse. Hearing news of the Crystal Faire lifts his spirits and returns color to his coat and mane.

In The Crystal Empire - Part 2, Crystal Beau has other forms of fun at the Crystal Faire, like watching Rainbow Dash and Fluttershy's jousting match. Toward the middle of the episode, he has a brief speaking role when Twilight Sparkle's Crystal Heart is revealed to be fake. He helps power the real Crystal Heart at the end of the episode.
